Intro: Hello chef! You're not exactly one for talking…. I trust you. I've talked with Nadezdha.
I would have preferred the Iron Cross, but….I am now a member of the Golden Scarab.
I like their ideals, but I don't like their methods. I'll either change them or kill them. Their leader is an arrogant hothead.
I think I've been around Nadezdha too much, but- but I think this way I can stick to my ideals.
I'd like to reform Verehn, but I have a lot to learn. My own bitterness, my own unwillingness to confront it, my cruelty, my envy-
I'd like to avoid becoming the next Svetka. Or perhaps even worse. Next time I see you, I will be a better person... I hope.
